settings.title: General Warranty Policy (90-Day Warranty Period)
settings.text: At Metpure Inc., we assure the utmost quality and craftmanship on every single one of our product and system we carry and sell. By providing this General Warranty Policy, we are demonstrating confidence in our quality products. Metpure Inc. will provide this General Warranty Policy as limited warranty on all of our products we sell for 90 days from the date of receiving the product from the original retail purchaser, unless otherwise noted on a particular product sold by Metpure Inc. that the warranty period exceeds the General Warranty Policy period of 90 days or an extended warranty was purchased separately. During this 90-Day General Warranty Policy period, Metpure Inc. will replace any part of the product which fails due to a defect in materials or workmanship. This General Warranty Policy is extended only to the original retail purchaser of the products purchased for home use within the USA, not for resellers or business account customers. Unless the products are specifically for non-home use applications, then in that case, that warranty policy will supersede this General Warranty Policy.

settings.code:
The following conditions apply to the 90-day limited warranty period of this General Warranty Policy:


● 90-day warranty starts from the date the original purchaser receives the product.

● This General Warranty Policy is not the return and refund policy. For details, visit our 30-Day Money Back Guarantee Refund Policy.

● In order to extend and grant this General Warranty Policy, Metpure Inc. may request for the actual defective product to be shipped to us and/or videos or pictures as documented proof to determine the cause and state of defect claimed by the original purchaser.

● Each purchased product comes with a 90-day warranty, unless you have purchased additional extended warranty offered directly by Metpure Inc.

● This General Warranty Policy covers the original retail purchaser and not business or reseller customers.

● Each purchased product comes with a 90-day warranty, unless the purchased product provides a longer warranty period, and in that case, that product warranty period will supersede this General Warranty Policy.

● Metpure Inc. agrees to the 90-day General Warranty Policy, provided it is promptly notified upon the discovery of any defects, to repair or replace any defective products due to poor quality or workmanship. Replacement parts may be new or refurbished, at the election of Metpure Inc.

● Shipment to you of repaired or replacement products shall be made in accordance with the provisions under Shipping Policy.

● In no event shall Metpure Inc. have any obligation to make repairs, replacement, or corrections required, in whole or in part, as the result of:

● (i) normal wear and tear,

● (ii) accident, disaster, or event of force majeure,

● (iii) misuse, abuse, fault, or negligence by you,

● (iv) not designed or suggested by the manufacturer or use of the products in a manner inconsistent with the installation instructions and manual,

● (v) causes internal to the products such as but not limited to power failure or electrical power surges,

● (vi) improper storage of the products, or

● (vii) use of the products in combination with equipment or parts not supplied by Metpure Inc.,

● (viii) water pressure, temperature, force, and specifications exceeding the recommended range stated by the product.

● Metpure Inc. is entitled to retain any defective part replaced under the General Warranty Policy.

● Metpure Inc. reserves the right to make design and product modifications or changes to product specifications without any contingent obligations to prospective buyers or owners of products previously sold.

● Under no circumstances are the conditions stated here negotiable, and no employees of Metpure Inc. or its authorized resellers have the authority to supersede the terms of the General Warranty Policy stated hereon.

● If Metpure Inc. determines that products for which you have requested warranty services are not covered by the warranty hereunder, you shall pay or reimburse Metpure Inc. for all costs of investigation and responding to such request at Metpure Inc.’s prevailing time and material rates.

● If Metpure Inc. provides repair services or replacement parts that are not covered by the warranty provided in this section, you shall pay Metpure Inc. for the prevailing time and materials rate.

● Any maintenance, repair, service, or alteration to or of, or other tampering with, products performed by any person or entity other than Metpure Inc. or without Metpure Inc.’s prior written approval, or any use of replacement parts not supplied or approved by Metpure Inc., or any alteration or tampering with product serial numbers, shall immediately void and cancel all warranties with respect to the affected products.

● Any incidental or consequential damages caused by possible defects with any products are not covered by this General Warranty Policy.

● Exclusion of implied warranties - your sole and exclusive remedy is defective part replacement as provided in this General Warranty Policy. Any implied warranties, including the implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose, are limited to 90 days or the shortest period allowed by law.

For warranty questions, service, or help, contact Metpure Inc. at support@metpure.com.

settings.custom_liquid:
Color Match Guarantee

Consistency in color and appearance is key to achieving a polished and harmonious kitchen sink counter-top fixture design. Mismatched finishes can disrupt the visual flow, making your kitchen feel less cohesive and unpleasant. That's why at Metpure, we set a high-quality control standard during the manufacturing process to ensure all different Metpure fixtures are made using the same precision color finish matching method to produce consistent color, gloss, and shine on all our kitchen sink fixture products. So, if you purchased a Metpure brushed nickel color kitchen faucet and a Metpure brushed nickel soap dispenser, we guarantee both products’ finish will match beautifully on your kitchen countertop.

If you purchased Metpure fixtures with the same color and they don't match, return them for a full refund. This guarantee does not apply to non-Metpure branded items.
